etsy.title: Circle Skirt Sewing Pattern PDF, Women's Full Circle Skirt XS-3X, Twirl Skirt with Waistband, Beginner Sewing Pattern A4 Letter A0
etsy.description:
A full circle skirt that twirls. One quarter-circle panel, cut twice on the fold, plus a straight waistband. The waist arc is calculated for every size, so the circle matches your waist exactly. Nested sizes XS to 3X.

WHAT'S INCLUDED
• Quarter-circle skirt panel (cut 2 on fold) and waistband
• Nested sizes XS, S, M, L, XL, 2X, 3X (choose by waist; see the size chart image)
• A4 and US Letter print-at-home files with a test square
• A0 copy shop file
• Sewing guide: fabric amounts, step-by-step sewing, how to hem a circle skirt
• Everything in English AND German (Deutsch): two downloads

GOOD TO KNOW
• No seam allowance included: add 1.5 cm (5/8 in), and 1 cm at the hem.
• Length 55 cm (21.5 in). Waist ease 1 cm.
• Drafted with the help of software from a standard size chart.
• Skill level: beginner.

DEUTSCH: Tellerrock mit Viertelkreis-Schnitt und Bund, Größen XS–3X, A4/Letter und A0, Nähanleitung auf Deutsch. Ohne Nahtzugabe.

INSTANT DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. PDF pattern only, no physical item will be shipped.
For personal use and small-batch handmade sales. Please don't share or resell the files.
